description: Replaces instances (`ids`, default the selection) by plain groups of their art as drawn (placement, scaled strokes and overrides baked in), no longer linked to the symbol. One undo step. Returns { ids } (the groups keep the instances' ids).

description: Renames symbol `symbolId`. One undo step. Returns the symbol summary.

label: Delete Symbol…
description: Deletes symbol `symbolId`. Fails while instances use it unless `detach: true` turns them into plain groups first. One undo step. Returns { ok }.

label: Edit Symbol
description: Enters isolation mode on a symbol (`id` of the symbol, or of one of its instances): the document then holds the symbol's art in its own space (registration point at 0, 0), so every vector.* command edits the art and every instance follows. Call vector.exitSymbolEdit when done. Not an undo step itself. Returns { symbolId, nodes } (vector.list for the art).

id.description: A symbol id (vector.listSymbols) or an instance id (vector.list).

label: Exit Symbol

label: List Constraints
description: Reads the parametric state: every constraint (id, kind, refs with anchor ids, value expression, name, evaluated value, satisfied), the named parameters, the degrees of freedom left (dof, status unconstrained / under / fully / over, redundant equations, per path) and any conflicts the last solve reported. label: Add Constraint…
description: Adds a constraint and solves (geometry moves as little as possible). Refs: anchors by { nodeId, subpath, index } (or anchor id), `handle`, `segment: true` (the line from the anchor to the next), or `circle: true` (a round path). Kinds: coincident (2 points, point + segment, point + circle), collinear (2 segments), concentric (2 circles or circle + point), fix (any), parallel / perpendicular (2 segments), horizontal / vertical (a segment or 2 points), tangent (segment + circle, 2 circles, or 1 anchor: G1), smooth (1 anchor: G2), symmetric (2 points + a segment axis), equal (2 segments or 2 circles), distance (a segment, 2 points or point + segment; `axis`), angle (2 segments, degrees), radius / diameter (a circle). Dimensional kinds take `value` (an expression; default the current measure) and `name`. Fails, changing nothing, on a conflict or a redundant constraint, naming the constraints involved. One undo step. Returns { id, constraint }.

anchor.description: The anchor's id instead of subpath / index (vector.listConstraints shows ids in use).

Returns the parametric summary (vector.listConstraints).

canvasHeight.description: Canvas height in screen pixels, to fit the page (optional).

label: List Connectors
description: Lists every connector: id, name, route, radius, and each end: the glued nodeId, its side setting and the side in use (resolvedSide), and where the end is (x, y, document units). An end without nodeId is free.

label: List Connection Sites
description: Returns the connection sites of an object: { sites: [{ side, x, y, nx, ny }] } in document units for top, right, bottom, left and centre (n is the outward normal). Empty for connectors, hidden objects or ones without extent.

label: Connect…
description: Adds a connector between two objects (or free points): each glued end follows its object whenever it moves, resizes or turns, through every later edit. Default: straight, the default stroke, a triangle arrowhead at the end. One undo step; selects it. Returns the connector as vector.listConnectors lists it.

start.description: An end glued to an object, { nodeId, side? }, or a free point { x, y } in document units.

nodeId.description: The object to glue to (not a connector).

side.description: Which site: the middle of the object's top, right, bottom or left side (its own, unrotated bounds, turned with it), its centre, or auto (the side facing the other end, chosen again on every edit; the default).

end.description: An end glued to an object, { nodeId, side? }, or a free point { x, y } in document units.

nodeId.description: The object to glue to (not a connector).

side.description: Which site: the middle of the object's top, right, bottom or left side (its own, unrotated bounds, turned with it), its centre, or auto (the side facing the other end, chosen again on every edit; the default).

route.description: straight (default), elbow (right angles, leaving and entering along the sides) or curved (an S-curve with handles along the sides).

radius.description: Corner radius of an elbow route's bends, document units (default 0).

gap.description: How far an elbow or curve runs straight out of a glued side before turning, document units (default 16).

stroke.description: A CSS colour, `null` for none, or a gradient object: `{ type: "linear" | "radial" | "conic" | "reflected" | "diamond", stops: [{ offset, color, opacity?, midpoint? }] }` plus the shorthand `angle` / `cx, cy, r` or explicit `start`, `end`, `width`, `focal`, `focalRadius`, `units`, and `spread`, `interpolation`, `smoothness`, `strokeMode` (see vector.setGradient).

type.description: linear, radial, conic (an angle sweep), reflected (linear mirrored about the start) or diamond.

midpoint.description: Where between this stop and the next the colours are half-mixed (default 0.5).

angle.description: Shorthand direction in degrees (0 up, clockwise): linear / reflected direction across the box, conic start angle, diamond turn.

cx.description: Shorthand centre x of radial / conic / diamond gradients, a fraction of the box (default 0.5).

r.description: Shorthand radius, a fraction of the box (default 0.5).

start.description: Explicit start (centre of radial / conic / diamond), in `units`. Wins over the shorthand.

end.description: Explicit end of the main axis (the radius of radial / conic / diamond).

width.description: End of the secondary axis (aspect and turn of radial / conic / diamond); default square to the main axis, as long.

focalRadius.description: Radial focal circle radius as a fraction of the radius (SVG fr).

units.description: Space of start / end / width / focal: fractions of the shape box (default) or the node's own coordinates.

spread.description: What paints past the ends: pad (default), reflect or repeat.

interpolation.description: Colour mixing space: srgb (default), linear (light) or oklab.

smoothness.description: Bends the ramp along a smooth spline through the stops (0 = straight).

strokeMode.description: On strokes: within (default, like a fill), along the path or across it.

strokeWidth.description: Stroke width in document units (default the editor default).

startArrow.description: Head at the start, or null for none (default none).

endArrow.description: Head at the end, or null for none (default triangle).

label: Connector Options…
description: Changes connectors (`ids`, default the selection): start / end glue an end to another object ({ nodeId, side? }) or unglue it (null; the end stays where it is); route, radius, gap set how they run. A plain open path given by id becomes a connector. Pass at least one. One undo step. Returns { connectors } as vector.listConnectors lists them.

ids.description: Connector (or open path) ids (default: the selection).

nodeId.description: The object to glue to (not a connector).

side.description: Which site: the middle of the object's top, right, bottom or left side (its own, unrotated bounds, turned with it), its centre, or auto (the side facing the other end, chosen again on every edit; the default).

start.description: Glue the start to { nodeId, side? }, or null to unglue it.

nodeId.description: The object to glue to (not a connector).

side.description: Which site: the middle of the object's top, right, bottom or left side (its own, unrotated bounds, turned with it), its centre, or auto (the side facing the other end, chosen again on every edit; the default).

end.description: Glue the end to { nodeId, side? }, or null to unglue it.

route.description: straight (default), elbow (right angles, leaving and entering along the sides) or curved (an S-curve with handles along the sides).

radius.description: Corner radius of an elbow route's bends, document units (default 0).

gap.description: How far an elbow or curve runs straight out of a glued side before turning, document units (default 16).

label: Snap Options
description: Returns the snap options: grid (0 = off), objects, guides, threshold (screen px), angles (polar / construction angles in degrees, counter-clockwise on the page), tracking, trackPolar, polarRelative.

label: Set Snap Options…
description: Changes how drawing snaps for people at the pointer (it does not move anything already drawn). polarIncrement sets angles to every multiple of it (plus additionalAngles). Pass at least one. Returns the options as vector.getSnapOptions does.

grid.description: Grid size in document units; 0 turns the grid off.

objects.description: Snap to other objects, construction angles and tracking.

guides.description: Show smart guide lines and labels.

threshold.description: How near a target pulls, in screen pixels (default 5).

angles.description: Polar / construction angles in degrees (counter-clockwise on the page). Overrides polarIncrement.

polarIncrement.description: Polar tracking increment in degrees (e.g. 15, 30, 45, 90): sets angles to its multiples.

additionalAngles.description: Extra polar angles in degrees, added to polarIncrement's.

tracking.description: Object snap tracking: resting the pointer on an anchor acquires it (default true).

trackPolar.description: Acquired points send paths at every polar angle, not only horizontal and vertical (default false).

polarRelative.description: The pen measures polar angles from its last segment (default false).

label: Draw by Dimensions…
description: Adds a path drawn by typed dimensions, as in CAD: from start, each step goes { length, angle } (degrees, counter-clockwise on the page: 0 right, 90 up), { dx, dy } (an offset) or { x, y } (a position), all in document units. closed joins the last point to the first. Default style. One undo step; selects it. Returns { id, anchors }.

start.description: The first point.

steps.description: Each next point: { length, angle }, { dx, dy } or { x, y }.

angle.description: Degrees counter-clockwise on the page (0 right, 90 up).

label: Get Mesh or Freeform Gradient
description: Returns a path's mesh or freeform fill with its points in document units: { id, shading } where shading is { type: "mesh", rows, columns, points (row by row), colors, opacities? } or { type: "freeform", points: [{ x, y, color, opacity?, spread? }], lines? }. Point indices are what the edit commands take.

label: Create Gradient Mesh…
description: Fills paths (`ids`, default the selection) with a gradient mesh over their bounds: rows × columns smooth patches whose points blend colours. Colour it with `colors` (one per point, (rows + 1) × (columns + 1), row by row) or the four `corners`, else the current fill colour, then move and recolour points with vector.setMeshPoint. One undo step. Returns { meshes: [{ id, shading }] }.

colors.description: A colour per point, row by row ((rows + 1) × (columns + 1) of them).

corners.description: Top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left colours, blended across.

label: Edit Mesh Point
description: Moves point `index` (row by row, from vector.getShading) of a path's gradient mesh to x, y (document units, both or neither) and / or sets its colour and opacity. One undo step. Returns { id, shading }.

index.description: Point index, row by row.

opacity.description: Opacity 0–1.

label: Create Freeform Gradient…
description: Fills paths (`ids`, default the selection) with a freeform gradient: colour `points` placed anywhere (document units) blending into each other, with optional `lines` that carry colour along smooth curves. Without points, four or more are placed inside each path, coloured along `colors` (default its fill to white). One undo step. Returns { gradients: [{ id, shading }] }.

opacity.description: Opacity 0–1 (default 1).

spread.description: Radius of pure colour round the point, as a fraction of half the shape's longer side (default 0).

lines.description: Lines, each the point indices (two or more) a smooth curve runs through; the colours flow along it.

colors.description: Without points: colours the placed points take, first to last.

label: Add Freeform Point
description: Adds a colour point to a path's freeform gradient at x, y (document units), coloured `color` (default: the colour there now). One undo step. Returns { id, index, shading }.

opacity.description: Opacity 0–1 (default 1).

spread.description: Radius of pure colour round the point, as a fraction of half the shape's longer side (default 0).

label: Edit Freeform Point
description: Changes point `index` (from vector.getShading) of a path's freeform gradient: x, y (document units, both or neither), color, opacity, spread. One undo step. Returns { id, shading }.

index.description: Point index.

opacity.description: Opacity 0–1 (default 1).

spread.description: Radius of pure colour round the point, as a fraction of half the shape's longer side (default 0).

label: Remove Freeform Point
description: Removes point `index` of a path's freeform gradient (never the last one); lines through it close up and later indices shift down. One undo step. Returns { id, shading }.

index.description: Point index.

label: Freeform Lines
description: Replaces the lines of a path's freeform gradient (an empty list removes them): each line is the point indices a smooth curve runs through, carrying the colours along it. One undo step. Returns { id, shading }.

lines.description: Lines, each the point indices (two or more) a smooth curve runs through; the colours flow along it.

label: Image Trace…
description: Traces a PNG (base64 data URL) into vector paths and adds them as one group: `threshold` mode makes one even-odd path where the image is dark (or opaque with channel alpha); `color` mode makes a stacked path per colour (median-cut to `colors`, the most common at the bottom). Placed with its top-left at x, y and `width` wide (default one unit per pixel). One undo step. Returns { id, paths: [{ id, name, fill, subpaths }] }.

image.description: The image as a data:image/png;base64,… URL (up to 4 million pixels).

mode.description: threshold (one colour, default) or color (a path per colour).

channel.description: Threshold mode: trace dark pixels (luminance, default) or opaque ones (alpha).

threshold.description: Threshold mode: inside where darkness (or alpha) reaches this (default 0.5).

tolerance.description: How far the outline may stray from the pixels, in pixels (default 1; larger is simpler).

minArea.description: Drop shapes smaller than this many square pixels (default 10).

cornerRoundness.description: 0: polygons with sharp corners; 1: smooth curves (default 0.5).

width.description: Width in document units (default: the image width in pixels).

label: Export Lottie
description: Returns the document (or `ids`) as Lottie (Bodymovin v5 JSON): one shape layer whose groups mirror the nodes, path effects as live Lottie modifiers (trim, round corners, pucker & bloat, twist, zig zag, offset, merge, repeater) and gradients as gradient fills. Returns { lottie, notes } where notes lists what was approximated (filters, text without outlines, mesh gradients…).

ids.description: Nodes to export (default: the whole document).

label: Import Lottie…
description: Adds one frame of a Lottie animation (JSON object or text) as editable groups on top (or replaces the document with `replace`, taking its size). Shape modifiers become live path effects; image and text layers, mattes and expressions are left out. One undo step. Returns { ids, notes }.

lottie.description: The Lottie animation: a JSON object, or its text.

frame.description: Which frame to read (default the in point).

replace.description: Replace the document instead of adding to it (default false).

label: Export PDF
description: Returns the drawing as a vector PDF (real paths, gradients as PDF shadings) as a base64 data URL: one page of the artboard, or one page per artboard (top-level frame) with pages "artboards". Returns { pdf, pages, bytes, notes }; notes lists what was approximated or left out (filters, opacity masks, text without glyph outlines).

pages.description: document: one page of the artboard (default); artboards: a page per top-level frame.

label: Make Symmetry…
description: Puts objects sharing a parent (`ids`, default the selection) into a live symmetry group: it draws them with their mirrored or rotated copies, which follow every edit of the originals. center defaults to the objects' centre (the artboard's with no objects: an empty group to add art to with parentId). One undo step. Returns { id, symmetry, children }.

ids.description: Objects to repeat (default: the selection; [] for an empty group).

mode.description: vertical (mirror left / right), horizontal (top / bottom), dual (four quarters), diagonal, or radial (turns round the centre).

rotation.description: Turn of the axes, degrees clockwise (default 0).

copies.description: Radial: how many turns round the circle (default 6).

mirror.description: Radial: mirror each turn too, like a kaleidoscope (default false).

label: Symmetry Options…
description: Changes symmetry groups (`ids`, default the selected one or the one holding the selection): mode, center, rotation, copies, mirror. Pass at least one. One undo step. Returns { groups }.

mode.description: vertical (mirror left / right), horizontal (top / bottom), dual (four quarters), diagonal, or radial (turns round the centre).

rotation.description: Turn of the axes, degrees clockwise (default 0).

copies.description: Radial: how many turns round the circle (default 6).

mirror.description: Radial: mirror each turn too, like a kaleidoscope (default false).

label: Release Symmetry
description: Stops symmetry groups repeating their children. With expand: true the copies become real, editable objects in the group (new ids); otherwise they go. One undo step. Returns { ids } of the objects expanding added.

expand.description: Keep the copies as real objects (default false).

label: Draw Inside Symmetry
description: Hands the canvas to the user drawing inside a top-level symmetry group: new pen, pencil, shape and text art goes into it, mirrored as it is drawn, until vector.exitSymmetry or Escape. Returns { id }.

label: Stop Drawing Inside Symmetry
description: New art goes on top of the document again (no symmetry group is entered). Returns { ok: true }.

label: Brushstroke Brushes
description: Lists the brushes a brushstroke can use (the dry presets, wet paint (watercolour, gouache, wet oils), the Mixer Brush, smudge and blender, then saved brushes from the brush library the vector profile admits): { brushes: [{ id, name, category, size, builtin }], colorScheme, colorLocked } (size: the brush's own diameter in document units; colorScheme picks the side of light / dark default colours; colorLocked: brushstrokes keep their colour, vector.setColorLocked).

label: Add Brushstroke…
description: Paints paths (`ids`, default the selection; groups: every path inside) with a natural-media brush along their outline, as a stroke layer of kind brushstroke: `brushId` from vector.listBrushes, `size` (document units), an optional `pressure` profile (0–1 values spread from start to end, e.g. [0.2, 1, 0.2] for a tapered stroke), `color`, `opacity` and gradient `paint` sampled dab by dab along the path. Wet paint (watercolour, gouache, wet oils) bleeds and dries; the scene shows it as laid until it settles, exports wait for it. The Mixer Brush, smudge and blender act on the shapes beneath the stroke (fills, strokes and brushstrokes; not text, images or effects). Pass a `seed` for the brush's character (seeded size, angle, opacity and scatter jitter plus a paper grain: what makes pencil, pastel and charcoal look real), with `paper` to choose the grain or null for none; without a seed the brush paints plain, even dabs. The path stays editable; the strokes follow it. One undo step. Returns { paths: [{ id, strokes }] } (the brushstroke is a stroke layer; change it with vector.setBrushstroke, remove it with vector.removeStroke).

size.description: Brush diameter in document units (default: the brush's own).

pressure.description: Pressure 0–1 along the length, spread evenly from start to end (default: full pressure).

color.description: CSS colour (default: the brush's own default colour, such as the ballpoint's blue, unless keepColour; else the path's stroke colour, else black).

keepColour.description: Ignore the brush's default colour and use the path's stroke colour (default false).

opacity.description: Layer opacity 0–1 (default 1).

index.description: Position in the stroke stack, 0 the bottom (default: on top).

seed.description: Character seed 0–2147483647: turns on the brush's jitter and paper grain; the same seed always renders the same stroke (default: none, plain dabs).

pattern.description: Grain pattern (default "sanded", a fine even tooth; "rough" and "cold-pressed" for watercolour paper, "canvas" and "linen" for a weave).

seed.description: Grain seed: another seed gives another sheet of the same paper (default 1).

scale.description: Grain scale: 1 is the pattern's natural size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How deep the grain is 0–1, times the brush's own grain response (default 0.5).

paper.description: With `seed`: the paper the grain comes from { pattern, seed, scale, depth }, or null for jitter without grain (default: the sanded paper).

anyOf.description: One colour instead of the layer colour (the layer colour still gives the alpha).

type.description: Always "color".

anyOf.description: Gradient paint: the brush samples it dab by dab along the path.

type.description: Always "gradient".

color.description: The stop colour as #rrggbb, or "paint" (the layer colour) or "secondary" (white).

opacity.description: Multiplies the brush flow where this colour is laid, 0..1 (default 1).

midpoint.description: Where between this stop and the next the colours are half mixed, 0.05..0.95 (default 0.5).

space.description: How neighbouring stops mix: pigment (default; like paint, blue to yellow passes green), oklab (perceptual) or srgb (plain numbers).

map.description: What moves the stroke along the gradient (default distance, 300 document units, mirror).

by.description: distance: document units (or dabs) travelled along the path; pressure: the pressure profile 0..1; tilt: no tilt on paths, so the start of the gradient; direction: direction of travel, once round per 360°; across-tip: left to right across the tip (a brush loaded with several colours); random: a seeded random point per dab (the layer seed). Paths have no timing, so velocity and time are not available.

length.description: distance: document units (or dabs, with unit "dabs") per run through the gradient (default 300).

repeat.description: distance: past the end, clamp (hold the last colour), repeat (start again) or mirror (run back; default).

unit.description: distance: document units ("px", default) or dabs.

softness.description: How softly neighbouring stops blend: 1 smooth (default) .. 0 hard steps.

paint.description: Gradient paint sampled dab by dab along the path instead of the colour, e.g. { type: "gradient", stops: [{ offset: 0, color: "#e11d48" }, { offset: 1, color: "#2563eb" }], map: { by: "distance", length: 200, repeat: "clamp" } } (default: the colour; a gradient layer colour or a gradient brush paints its own gradient).

label: Edit Brushstroke…
description: Changes the brushstroke at stroke layer `index` of path `id` (vector.getAppearance lists strokes; 0 is the bottom): `brushId` (the same id again takes that saved brush as the library has it now), `size` (null: the brush's own), `pressure` (null: full pressure), `color`, `opacity`, `seed` (turns the brush's character on; null: plain dabs), `paper` (replaced whole; null: no grain; {}: the default paper) and gradient `paint` (null: the colour). Pass at least one. One undo step. Returns { id, strokes }.

index.description: Stroke layer index of the brushstroke.

size.description: Diameter in document units, or null for the brush's own.

pressure.description: Pressure profile 0–1 from start to end, or null for full pressure.

color.description: CSS colour (with another brushId and no color, the new brush's default colour, if it has one, unless keepColour).

keepColour.description: With another brushId: keep the layer's colour instead of taking the new brush's default colour (default false).

opacity.description: Layer opacity 0–1.

seed.description: Character seed 0–2147483647 (jitter and paper grain; a new seed gives a new take on the same stroke), or null for plain dabs.

pattern.description: Grain pattern (default "sanded", a fine even tooth; "rough" and "cold-pressed" for watercolour paper, "canvas" and "linen" for a weave).

seed.description: Grain seed: another seed gives another sheet of the same paper (default 1).

scale.description: Grain scale: 1 is the pattern's natural size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How deep the grain is 0–1, times the brush's own grain response (default 0.5).

paper.description: The paper the grain comes from { pattern, seed, scale, depth } (applies with a seed), null for no grain, or {} for the default sanded paper.

anyOf.description: One colour instead of the layer colour (the layer colour still gives the alpha).

type.description: Always "color".

anyOf.description: Gradient paint: the brush samples it dab by dab along the path.

type.description: Always "gradient".

color.description: The stop colour as #rrggbb, or "paint" (the layer colour) or "secondary" (white).

opacity.description: Multiplies the brush flow where this colour is laid, 0..1 (default 1).

midpoint.description: Where between this stop and the next the colours are half mixed, 0.05..0.95 (default 0.5).

space.description: How neighbouring stops mix: pigment (default; like paint, blue to yellow passes green), oklab (perceptual) or srgb (plain numbers).

map.description: What moves the stroke along the gradient (default distance, 300 document units, mirror).

by.description: distance: document units (or dabs) travelled along the path; pressure: the pressure profile 0..1; tilt: no tilt on paths, so the start of the gradient; direction: direction of travel, once round per 360°; across-tip: left to right across the tip (a brush loaded with several colours); random: a seeded random point per dab (the layer seed). Paths have no timing, so velocity and time are not available.

length.description: distance: document units (or dabs, with unit "dabs") per run through the gradient (default 300).

repeat.description: distance: past the end, clamp (hold the last colour), repeat (start again) or mirror (run back; default).

unit.description: distance: document units ("px", default) or dabs.

softness.description: How softly neighbouring stops blend: 1 smooth (default) .. 0 hard steps.

paint.description: Gradient paint sampled dab by dab along the path (replaced whole), or null to paint the colour again.

label: Keep My Colour
description: Locks or unlocks the brushstroke colour ("Keep my colour"): while locked, vector.addBrushstroke and vector.setBrushstroke with another brushId keep the colour (the path's stroke colour, or the layer's) instead of taking the brush's default colour; an explicit color still applies. Strokes already made are unchanged. Editor state, not an undo step. Returns { colorScheme, colorLocked }.

locked.description: true locks the colour, false unlocks it (the editor starts unlocked).

label: Brush Colours for Light / Dark
description: Sets the colour scheme that picks the side of a brush's light / dark default colour for brushstrokes made from now on (white chalk in dark, dark chalk in light). Strokes already made keep their colour. The host usually sets it to match its theme. Editor state, not an undo step. Returns { colorScheme, colorLocked }.

scheme.description: light (dark chalk on a light background) or dark (light chalk on a dark one).

label: Mosaic from Image…
description: Turns a PNG into mosaic tiles: a square or round tile per cell in the colour under it. Added as one group placed with its top-left at x, y and width wide; colours of one kind share a compound path. One undo step. Returns { id, paths: [{ id, name, fill, subpaths }] }.

image.description: The picture as a data:image/png;base64,… URL (up to 4 million pixels).

width.description: Width in document units (default: the image width in pixels).

cell.description: Tile size in image pixels (default 12); larger draws fewer, bigger shapes.

gap.description: Grout between tiles as a fraction of the tile (default 0.1).

label: Halftone from Image…
description: Turns a PNG into halftone dots on a turned grid, each dot's area following how dark the picture is there. Added as one group placed with its top-left at x, y and width wide; colours of one kind share a compound path. One undo step. Returns { id, paths: [{ id, name, fill, subpaths }] }.

image.description: The picture as a data:image/png;base64,… URL (up to 4 million pixels).

width.description: Width in document units (default: the image width in pixels).

cell.description: Dot spacing in image pixels (default 8); larger draws fewer, bigger shapes.

angle.description: Screen angle in degrees (default 45).

color.description: Ink colour (default black); null keeps the picture's colours, reduced to `colors`.

label: Low Poly from Image…
description: Turns a PNG into low-poly art: a jittered grid of triangles, each in the colour under it. Added as one group placed with its top-left at x, y and width wide; colours of one kind share a compound path. One undo step. Returns { id, paths: [{ id, name, fill, subpaths }] }.

image.description: The picture as a data:image/png;base64,… URL (up to 4 million pixels).

width.description: Width in document units (default: the image width in pixels).

cell.description: Triangle size in image pixels (default 24); larger draws fewer, bigger shapes.

jitter.description: How far the grid points wander, as a fraction of a cell (default 0.35).

seed.description: Seed of the wandering (default 1): the same seed gives the same triangles.

label: Engraving from Image…
description: Turns a PNG into an engraving: parallel lines on a turned grid that swell where the picture is dark and break where it is light. Added as one group placed with its top-left at x, y and width wide; colours of one kind share a compound path. One undo step. Returns { id, paths: [{ id, name, fill, subpaths }] }.

image.description: The picture as a data:image/png;base64,… URL (up to 4 million pixels).

width.description: Width in document units (default: the image width in pixels).

cell.description: Line spacing in image pixels (default 6); larger draws fewer, bigger shapes.

angle.description: Line angle in degrees (default 45).

label: Perspective Grid
description: Reads the document's perspective grid: { perspective: { vanishingPoints, origin, gridSize, extent, visible } or null, planes (the planes it has), drawingOn (the plane new shapes are drawn on, or null) }.

label: Perspective Grid…
description: Sets the document's perspective grid (CorelDRAW's Perspective Drawing): 1 vanishing point (planes floor, side, front), 2 (floor, left, right; walls recede to the first and second) or 3 (the third is where the walls' verticals meet). Put the vanishing points on the horizon line and the origin below it, where the planes meet. One undo step. Returns the grid as vector.getPerspective does.

origin.description: Where the planes meet (document units), not on a vanishing point.

gridSize.description: Grid cell size at the origin, document units (default 20).

extent.description: Cells drawn out from the origin along each axis (default 12).

visible.description: Show the grid on the canvas (default true).

label: Remove Perspective Grid
description: Removes the perspective grid (art already on its planes stays as drawn). One undo step. Returns { perspective: null }.

label: Draw on Perspective Plane
description: Makes the Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon and Star tools draw on a plane of the grid (their drag box is taken on the plane, so shapes recede with it), or flat again with plane null. Not an undo step. Returns the grid as vector.getPerspective does.

plane.description: A plane of the grid: floor, left and right (2 or 3 vanishing points), or floor, side and front (1 point). null draws flat.

label: Attach to Perspective
description: Lays objects (`ids`, default the selection) onto a plane of the grid: each is read flat relative to the grid origin (right and up) and projected, so art near the origin keeps its size and further art recedes. Draw or place the flat art beside the origin first. Text and instances must be outlines (vector.createOutlines). One undo step. Returns { ids }.

plane.description: A plane of the grid: floor, left and right (2 or 3 vanishing points), or floor, side and front (1 point).

label: Lens…
description: Makes closed paths (`ids`, default the selection) lenses, or changes their lens: inside its outline, what is drawn below shows changed (magnify, fisheye, brighten, invert, tintedGrayscale, colorAdd, colorLimit, heatMap, wireframe, or the lens's own fill see-through for transparency). The lens follows every edit below it; its bounds stay its own shape. Pass type to make or switch a lens (missing values take that type's defaults); omit it to change amount or color of existing lenses. One undo step. Returns { lenses: [{ id, lens }] }.

ids.description: Closed paths to make or change (default: the selection).

type.description: What the lens does. Required for a path that is not a lens yet.

amount.description: Strength, by type: transparency 0…100 percent see-through (default 50); magnify 1…20 times (default 2); fisheye -100…100 percent, negative pinches (default 50); brighten -100…100 percent, negative darkens (default 40); invert 0…100 percent strength (default 100); tintedGrayscale 0…100 percent strength (default 100); colorAdd 0…100 percent of the colour added (default 50); colorLimit 0…100 percent strength (default 100); heatMap 0…100 percent the palette is turned (default 0); wireframe 0…100 percent outline opacity (default 100).

color.description: CSS colour for tintedGrayscale, colorAdd, colorLimit and wireframe (default per type; ignored by the others).

label: Remove Lens
description: Makes lenses (`ids`, default the selection) plain paths again; ids that are not lenses are skipped. One undo step. Returns { ids } of the paths that stopped being lenses.

label: Corner Radius…
description: Sets the live corner radius (and optionally `kind`: round, inverted or chamfer, and `smoothing`) of `anchors`, else the selected points (direct tool), else every corner of `ids` / the selection. Radius 0 makes corners sharp; radii shrink to fit short sides. `smoothing` (0–1) turns round corners between straight sides into squircles (Figma / iOS style continuous corners), easing into a shorter arc over (1 + smoothing) times the distance. The anchors stay editable.

radius.description: Corner radius in document units (0: sharp).

smoothing.description: Squircle smoothing of round corners between straight sides, 0 (a circular arc, default) to 1 (0.6 is iOS-like).

anchors.description: Anchors as { nodeId, subpath, index } (default: the selected points).

label: Width Profile…
description: Gives the stroke of paths a variable width: a `preset` (`uniform` removes the profile), explicit `points` ({ t, left, right }: side scales along each subpath), or a parametric `taper` (startLength / endLength as fractions of the path, startWidth / endWidth 0–1, startEase / endEase 0–1) and / or `wave` (amount 0–1, cycles, phase in degrees). Profiled strokes draw as filled outlines; Outline Stroke bakes them.

t.description: Position along each subpath by length (0 start, 1 end).

left.description: Left side as a multiple of half the stroke width (1 = uniform).

right.description: Right side (looking along the path, y down).

points.description: Variable-width profile points, interpolated smoothly (monotone cubic); two points at one `t` make a step. `null` or `[]` strokes at a uniform width.

label: Width Point…
description: Sets one width point of a path's stroke profile numerically: `index` names an existing point (see `vector.setWidthProfile`'s result), leave it out to add one at `t`. `left` / `right` are side widths in document units (how far the stroke reaches on each side), `t` the position along each subpath (0–1); a point moved onto another's `t` makes a step. Returns the profile.

label: Outline Stroke
description: Turns the stroke of paths into filled shapes of the area it paints (alignment, caps, joins, dashes and arrowheads included). Returns the new ids.

label: Free Distort…
description: Free Distort: moves the four corners of the selection box (clockwise from the top left, in the box’s own rotation) to `corners` in document units, distorting the nodes in perspective (straight lines stay straight; curves are followed within `tolerance`). The corners must make a convex quadrilateral. One undo step.

corners.description: New top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left corners.

tolerance.description: How closely curves follow the distortion (document units, default 0.05).

label: Skew…
description: Skews nodes along the selection box’s axes: `ax` degrees horizontally (vertical lines lean right for positive angles) and `ay` degrees vertically, about the box centre or `origin`. One undo step.

label: Envelope Distort…
description: Envelope distortion that stays editable (a live `envelope` effect). Give `preset` (with `bend`, `horizontal`, `vertical` in percent, −100…100, and `orientation`) to warp, or `mesh` ({ rows, columns } and optionally `points`, the control grid row by row in the node’s own space) for an editable mesh; a node that already has an envelope is changed. `topObject: true` uses the topmost selected closed path as the envelope of the others; `release: true` removes the envelope and gives back its shape as a path; `expand: true` bakes it (Expand Appearance). One undo step.

points.description: (3·columns + 1) × (3·rows + 1) control points, row by row (node space).

label: Transform…
description: Moves (dx, dy), scales (sx, sy, along the selection box axes) and/or rotates (`rotate`: by degrees clockwise around the combined centre; `angle`: to an absolute rotation, each node around its own centre), in that order.

label: Delete
description: Deletes nodes.

label: Rename Layer…
description: Renames node `id` (a path, group, text or any layer) to `name`, as the Layers panel shows it. One undo step. Returns { id, name }.

label: Boolean Operation…
description: Combines two or more paths with union, subtract (upper shapes from the lowest), intersect or exclude. With `live`, the shapes stay editable operands of a live boolean group instead (a lone live group gets the operation; its operands get their own).

live.description: Keep the operands editable in a live boolean group (default false: one new path).

label: Add Path Effect…
description: Adds a live path effect to the bottom of the effect stack of nodes (paths or groups). Effects apply top to bottom; effects after a repeater act on its copies. Returns the new effect ids.

params.description: Effect parameters (missing ones keep their value or default). trim: start, end (percent), offset (degrees), mode simultaneous|individual. roundCorners: radius. puckerBloat: amount (−100…100). twist: angle, center {x, y} (offset from the middle). zigzag: size, ridges, smooth. wiggle: size, detail, smooth, speed, correlation, phase, seed, time (seconds). offset: amount, join miter|round|bevel, miterLimit, copies, copyOffset. merge: mode merge|add|subtract|intersect|exclude. repeater: copies (fractions fade the last), offset, position {x, y}, anchor {x, y} (offset from the middle), rotation, scale {x, y} (percent), startOpacity, endOpacity (percent), composite below|above. contour: direction inside|outside|center, steps, offset, fillColor / strokeColor (end colours, null keeps the colour), acceleration (−100…100), join. blockShadow: angle (degrees, 0 right, 90 down), distance, color (null: the shape fill colour), opacity, endOpacity (percent; lower than opacity fades it into a long shadow). extrude: mode parallel|perspective, angle (degrees) and depth (units) for parallel, vanishingPoint {x, y} (offset from the middle) and toward (percent of the way there) for perspective, color (null: the shape fill colour), lightAngle (degrees the light comes from, 0 right, -90 above), shading (percent). bevel: width (units), lightAngle (degrees), shading (percent), color (null: the shape fill colour). envelope: style (a warp preset: arc|arcLower|arcUpper|arch|bulge|shellLower|shellUpper|flag|wave|fish|rise|fisheye|inflate|squeeze|twist, or mesh), bend, horizontal, vertical (percent, −100…100), orientation horizontal|vertical, rows, columns, mesh { us, vs, points } (node space; prefer vector.envelope).

index.description: Position in the stack (default: last).

label: Edit Path Effect…
description: Changes a path effect: its parameters, whether it is enabled, and its position in the stack.

params.description: Effect parameters (missing ones keep their value or default). trim: start, end (percent), offset (degrees), mode simultaneous|individual. roundCorners: radius. puckerBloat: amount (−100…100). twist: angle, center {x, y} (offset from the middle). zigzag: size, ridges, smooth. wiggle: size, detail, smooth, speed, correlation, phase, seed, time (seconds). offset: amount, join miter|round|bevel, miterLimit, copies, copyOffset. merge: mode merge|add|subtract|intersect|exclude. repeater: copies (fractions fade the last), offset, position {x, y}, anchor {x, y} (offset from the middle), rotation, scale {x, y} (percent), startOpacity, endOpacity (percent), composite below|above. contour: direction inside|outside|center, steps, offset, fillColor / strokeColor (end colours, null keeps the colour), acceleration (−100…100), join. blockShadow: angle (degrees, 0 right, 90 down), distance, color (null: the shape fill colour), opacity, endOpacity (percent; lower than opacity fades it into a long shadow). extrude: mode parallel|perspective, angle (degrees) and depth (units) for parallel, vanishingPoint {x, y} (offset from the middle) and toward (percent of the way there) for perspective, color (null: the shape fill colour), lightAngle (degrees the light comes from, 0 right, -90 above), shading (percent). bevel: width (units), lightAngle (degrees), shading (percent), color (null: the shape fill colour). envelope: style (a warp preset: arc|arcLower|arcUpper|arch|bulge|shellLower|shellUpper|flag|wave|fish|rise|fisheye|inflate|squeeze|twist, or mesh), bend, horizontal, vertical (percent, −100…100), orientation horizontal|vertical, rows, columns, mesh { us, vs, points } (node space; prefer vector.envelope).

index.description: Move it to this position in the stack (0 applies first).

label: Remove Path Effect
description: Removes a path effect from a node.

label: Expand Appearance
description: Bakes the path effects and live booleans of nodes (and everything inside them) into plain paths.

label: Make Blend…
description: Blends two or more paths or groups (sharing a parent; bottom to top, or in the order given with keepOrder) into a live blend group: the in-betweens morph shape (anchors matched by arc length, the start and winding that twist least, rotation-aware so turning shapes turn) and paint (OKLab colours, gradients, stroke width, opacity, width profiles), and regenerate whenever a key changes. Spacing: `steps` (count between each pair of keys), `distance` (along the spine) or `smoothColor`. `starts` maps key ids to the anchor of their first subpath the blend starts from. Returns the blend id.

steps.description: In-betweens between each pair of keys (steps spacing; default 5).

distance.description: Distance between in-betweens along the spine (distance spacing; default 20).

orientToSpine.description: Turn the in-betweens with a replaced spine.

linear.description: Move anchors in straight lines instead of the rotation-aware morph.

keepOrder.description: Blend in the order of `ids` instead of stacking order.

label: Blend Options…
description: Changes the spacing (steps, distance or smoothColor), step count, distance, orient-to-spine and linear morph of the given (or selected) blends; their steps regenerate.

steps.description: In-betweens between each pair of keys (steps spacing; default 5).

distance.description: Distance between in-betweens along the spine (distance spacing; default 20).

orientToSpine.description: Turn the in-betweens with a replaced spine.

linear.description: Move anchors in straight lines instead of the rotation-aware morph.

label: Expand Blend
description: Expands the given (or selected) blends into plain groups of their keys and in-betweens (editable paths with fresh ids). Returns the group ids.

label: Release Blend
description: Releases the given (or selected) blends: the in-betweens go and the keys (plus a replaced spine, as an unpainted path) take the blend's place. Returns their ids.

label: Replace Spine
description: With one blend and one path given (or selected): the path becomes the blend's spine (it is removed) and the keys move onto it, spread evenly by arc length; the in-betweens follow it.

label: Pathfinder…
description: Pathfinder over the given paths (bottom to top): divide (every face its own shape, painted like the top-most shape over it; open unfilled paths cut), trim (hidden parts removed), merge (trim, then touching parts of one fill joined), crop (the top shape crops the others), outline (outlines cut into open strokes where they meet) or minusBack (the top shape minus everything below). Results replace the paths, grouped when there are several.

label: List Shape Builder Faces
description: Lists the faces the given paths divide the plane into: path data, area, a point inside and the ids of the paths filling each (empty when only outlines enclose it).

label: Shape Builder
description: Shape Builder gesture over the faces of the given paths: `points` is the pointer path in document units (one point is a click; [[x, y], …]; use the points from shapeBuilderFaces). Merges the faces it touches into one shape, or with `erase: true` deletes them, the pieces of unfilled open paths and the edges of other outlines (cut where paths meet) within `tolerance`; a deleted edge opens its path there, and edges bounding a deleted face go with it. Shapes covering those faces lose that area. Returns the counts of faces, line pieces and edges.

label: Fill Region
description: Paint bucket: fills the area the visible outlines enclose around `point` (crossings split, nested shapes left as holes) with a new path in the current fill, below the selection or on top. `gap` closes gaps up to that size between loose ends.

label: Align…
description: Aligns nodes to their combined bounds, or to the artboard (`to: "artboard"`, or when only one node is given).

label: Distribute…
description: Spaces three or more nodes with equal gaps.

label: Place Callouts…
description: Moves labels (text, or any node) near what they describe, clear of the other art and of each other, and draws a thin leader line from each anchor to its label when they are apart. Each label gives its node `id` and an `anchor` point in document units, or an `anchorId` node (its top centre). Tries the `prefer` sides first (default above, right, below, left, then the corners), stepping outwards, inside the artboard. One undo step. Returns each label's new box, side, `ok` (false when no clear spot was left) and its leader id, and the total `clashes`. Refuses, changing nothing, an unknown or locked label, an unknown anchor node, or a label without an anchor.

id.description: The label node (usually text) to move.

anchor.description: The point the label belongs to.

anchorId.description: A node the label belongs to instead of a point (its top centre).

prefer.description: Sides to try, best first (default above, right, below, left, then the corners; center puts a label on its anchor).

gap.description: Space kept between labels, document units (default 2).

distance.description: First distance from the anchor, document units (default 12 with leaders, else 4).

label: Add Isometric Blocks…
description: Adds isometric (2.5D) blocks: each box in grid units (i runs down-right, j down-left, k up; each axis from low to high, k0 = k1 for a flat tile) becomes a group of editable face paths (Left, Right, Top), shaded from one `fill` (the top as given, the sides darker) or given per face, with optional `grid` lines on the faces at whole multiples of the step. All boxes go in one group, drawn back to front. `scale` is document units per grid unit (default 20), `angle` the axes' slope (default 30), `origin` where (0, 0, 0) lands (default: the blocks centred on the artboard). One undo step. Returns the group `id` and, per box in input order, its group id, face ids, grid id and `outline` (its six-sided silhouette in document units, e.g. for vector.placeCallouts anchors). Refuses, adding nothing, a box whose axes do not run low to high, an angle outside 1 to 89 or a scale that is not positive.

i0.description: Start along i (down and to the right), grid units.

i1.description: End along i, more than i0.

j0.description: Start along j (down and to the left), grid units.

j1.description: End along j, more than j0.

k1.description: Top, at least k0 (equal: a flat tile).

anyOf.description: A colour: the top as given, the left face 15% darker, the right 30% (hex colours; others are used on every face).

stroke.description: Edge colour (default a shade of each face; null for none).

angle.description: Slope of the i and j axes, degrees (default 30: true isometric).

origin.description: Where grid point (0, 0, 0) lands (default: the blocks centred on the artboard).

grid.description: Draw grid lines on the faces every this many grid units (default none).

label: Arrange…
description: Changes stacking order within each node’s parent.

label: Move Layer…
description: Moves one node to a position among its siblings (0 the bottom; default the top), as dragging it in the layers panel does. With `parentId` it moves into that group, or with null to the top level; it stays where it is on the canvas.

index.description: Position among its new siblings, bottom to top (default: the top).

parentId.description: The group to move into, or null for the top level (default: its current parent).

label: Group
description: Groups nodes that share a parent.

label: Ungroup
description: Replaces groups with their children.

label: Delete Points
description: Deletes anchors. With `keepShape` (default: the editor setting, on) the neighbouring handles are refitted so the outline keeps its shape; off, the neighbours are joined as they are.

anchors.description: Anchors as { nodeId, subpath, index } (default: the selected points).

label: Move Point…
description: Moves one anchor to (x, y) in document units. `curvature: true` bends its two segments like the Curvature tool instead of carrying its handles along.

label: Bend Segment…
description: Bends segment `segment` (from anchor `segment` to the next) so the curve passes through (x, y) at parameter `t` (default 0.5).

label: Join
description: Joins the open subpaths of paths nearest endpoints first (ends within `tolerance` merge); a single open path is closed.

label: Average Points…
description: Moves anchors onto their average position: the same y (`horizontal`), the same x (`vertical`) or the same point (`both`, default).

anchors.description: Anchors as { nodeId, subpath, index } (default: the selected points).

label: Remove Redundant Points
description: Drops anchors that can go without moving the outline more than `tolerance` document units (default 0.5).

label: Smooth Path
description: Pulls the handles of paths (or of the selected points) towards smooth tangents by `amount` (0–1, default 1).

anchors.description: Anchors as { nodeId, subpath, index } (default: the selected points).

label: Cut Path (Scissors)…
description: Scissors: cuts path `nodeId` at the outline point nearest (x, y), or cuts at `anchors`. A closed path opens; an open one splits in two.

anchors.description: Anchors as { nodeId, subpath, index } (default: the selected points).

label: Knife…
description: Cuts closed paths along a polyline wherever it crosses them edge to edge (no gap between pieces). Cuts `ids`, else the selection, else every path the line crosses.

label: Erase…
description: Erases a round stroke of diameter `size` (default: the eraser size setting) along a polyline: filled shapes lose the area, outlines are cut under it. Erases from `ids`, else the selection, else every path it reaches.

label: Smudge Brush…
description: Smudges outlines along a stroke: what is under the brush is pushed the way it moves, most at its centre (CorelDRAW's Smudge). One undo step. Returns { ids } of the changed paths; fails, changing nothing, when the brush reaches no outline.

points.description: The brush stroke [[x, y], …] in document units: at least two points.

ids.description: Paths to distort (default: the selection, else every path the brush reaches).

radius.description: Brush radius, document units (default: the distortSize setting, 20).

strength.description: Strength at the brush centre, 0–1, fading to 0 at the rim (default: the distortStrength setting, 0.5).

label: Twirl Brush…
description: Twirls the outlines under the brush about each point (CorelDRAW's Twirl). One undo step. Returns { ids } of the changed paths; fails, changing nothing, when the brush reaches no outline.

points.description: Where the brush dabs [[x, y], …], document units: one dab per point.

ids.description: Paths to distort (default: the selection, else every path the brush reaches).

radius.description: Brush radius, document units (default: the distortSize setting, 20).

strength.description: Strength at the brush centre, 0–1, fading to 0 at the rim (default: the distortStrength setting, 0.5).

angle.description: Degrees turned at the brush centre per point, clockwise on screen; negative turns the other way (default 15).

label: Attract Brush…
description: Pulls the outlines under the brush toward each point (CorelDRAW's Attract). One undo step. Returns { ids } of the changed paths; fails, changing nothing, when the brush reaches no outline.

points.description: Where the brush dabs [[x, y], …], document units: one dab per point.

ids.description: Paths to distort (default: the selection, else every path the brush reaches).

radius.description: Brush radius, document units (default: the distortSize setting, 20).

strength.description: Strength at the brush centre, 0–1, fading to 0 at the rim (default: the distortStrength setting, 0.5).

label: Repel Brush…
description: Pushes the outlines under the brush away from each point (CorelDRAW's Repel). One undo step. Returns { ids } of the changed paths; fails, changing nothing, when the brush reaches no outline.

points.description: Where the brush dabs [[x, y], …], document units: one dab per point.

ids.description: Paths to distort (default: the selection, else every path the brush reaches).

radius.description: Brush radius, document units (default: the distortSize setting, 20).

strength.description: Strength at the brush centre, 0–1, fading to 0 at the rim (default: the distortStrength setting, 0.5).

label: Roughen Brush…
description: Breaks the outlines under the brush into spikes (CorelDRAW's Roughen): use for fur, grass and torn edges. One undo step. Returns { ids } of the changed paths; fails, changing nothing, when the brush reaches no outline.

points.description: Where the brush dabs [[x, y], …], document units: one dab per point.

ids.description: Paths to distort (default: the selection, else every path the brush reaches).

radius.description: Brush radius, document units (default: the distortSize setting, 20).

strength.description: Strength at the brush centre, 0–1, fading to 0 at the rim (default: the distortStrength setting, 0.5).

seed.description: Seed of the spikes (default 1): the same seed gives the same spikes.

label: Path Editing Options…
description: Sets how editing behaves: `keepShapeOnDelete`, `curvatureMoves` (anchor drags bend like the Curvature tool), `pencilSmoothing` (lazy mouse, 0–1), `recognizeShapes` (pencil scribbles become lines, rectangles, ellipses, polygons), `eraserSize`, the Distort Brush settings `distortMode` (smudge, twirl, attract, repel, roughen), `distortSize` (radius) and `distortStrength` (0–1), and `pencilPressure` (`pen`: record pen pressure on pencil strokes as a width profile, `all`: any pointer reporting pressure, `off`).

distortMode.description: What the Distort Brush tool does when the user drags it.

label: Choose Tool…
description: Switches the canvas tool.

label: Export SVG
description: Returns the document as SVG markup.

label: Import SVG…
description: Adds the shapes of SVG markup on top of the document (or replaces it with `replace: true`).
